title: Flip receipt
description: Printed by `coin flip --json`: one flip from the entropy pool, and everything it came from. With the archived run in data/runs and the batch's recorded seed, the bit can be recomputed.

flipped_at.description: When the bit was spent, ISO 8601 in UTC.

backend.description: The IBM device the shots ran on.

qubit.description: The physical qubit that was flipped.

run.description: The archived run's directory under data/runs/.

harvested_at.description: When the batch entered the pool, ISO 8601 in UTC.

batch.description: The pool batch the bit came from.

offset.description: The bit's position in its batch, from 0.

batch_bits.description: How many bits the batch holds.

entropy_per_bit.description: Min-entropy per shot the extraction spent: half the estimate.

epsilon.description: Distance from uniform, if that min-entropy holds.
